title: NEW: the r2 W1 typed-compare pins are vacuous since r4 — both stale-bounce fixtures use single-email entries the batch-shape exclusion removes before send_is_post_correction is ever evaluated
detail: Post-correction (cycles=1) the single email entries fail the batch-shape exclusion (email with no sms sibling at the same at) and the fallback legs require correction_cycles = 0, so find_reference_call_by_send_ref returns no row and the tests pass via the not-found no-op. send_is_post_correction=false is evaluated by no test; a regression of the typed compare ships green, and a redelivered pre-correction bounce of a genuine email+sms batch (the real sweep shape) would fabricate referee_contact_invalid.
recommended_fix: Give one stale fixture the genuine-batch shape (email + sms sibling at the pre-correction at) so the find matches and the typed compare's false arm is exercised, and correct the tests' comments describing the mechanism.
